title: Fourteen Winters and One Short Table
subtitle: 经济发展 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济发展（人与社会·经济生活）
meta: 主题语境：经济发展（人与社会·经济生活）　|　核心词汇：economy　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 economy 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1949 my father ① watched the economy that no merchant in the port would have described, and he said the watching was the whole of the winter. The ② economy, meaning the system and not the saving, ran fourteen winters and stayed unnamed in the book; an economy, he said, is the only thing in a port that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ economy in that port had the same short table at the end of it, and the ④ economy at the end, meaning the one they kept for the coast and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. An economy, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; my father said the describing is the part that fills fourteen winters.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the economy was the whole of the story, meaning the saving and not the system. The ⑥ economy, meaning the saving and not any of that, is the only thing in a story that everybody urges and nobody practises; economy, he said, is either something you watch or the only word that means both a system and a saving. He said the saving is the part they remember.

By 1958 the ⑦ economy had become a line in a yearbook, and the yearbook had become an argument about the short table. The ⑧ economy of the whole thing, my father wrote in January, was one port and fourteen winters of describing; economy, he said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to describe. She said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ economy I remember is the one named in the yearbook, which turned in 1970 and is still described as the quietest in the port. An ⑩ economy, my mother said in 1972, is the only one that improves by being described; every economy, she said, is a saving that has agreed to look like a system. She said the saving was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 经济；经济体（指那个港口里观察过的那一套）
B. n. 经济；经济体（指那套经济本身，与节约相对）
C. 固定搭配：watch the economy 观察一地经济
D. n. 经济；经济体（指留给沿海的那一块）
E. n. 经济；经济体（抽象总称，指一个港口的经济之事）
F. n. 经济；经济体（指年鉴上写到、被列名的那一套）
G. n. 节约；节俭（指故事里人人都提倡却无人做到的那样东西）
H. n. 节约（抽象总称，指人人都提倡却无人做到的那种做法）

items.q: watched the economy that no merchant in the port would have described
The economy, meaning the system and not the saving
the economy was the whole of the story
the economy had become a line in a yearbook
The economy of the whole thing
An economy, my mother said in 1972

answers.why: watch the economy 意为“观察一地经济”，1949 年父亲观察了一个港口里没有一位商人肯描述的经济。
economy 意为“经济、经济体”，指那套经济本身而不是节约，它经过了十四个冬天而在簿子上没有名字。
economy 意为“经济、经济体”，指那个港口里的每一套经济，每一套后头都有同一张小小的表格。
economy 意为“经济、经济体”，指留给沿海的那一块，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
economy 意为“节约、节俭”，指故事里人人都提倡却无人做到的那样东西，叔叔说这份节俭就是那个故事的全部。
economy 意为“节约”，指人人都提倡却无人做到的那种做法而不是那套经济，是故事里人人都提倡、却无人做到的东西。
economy 意为“经济、经济体”，指年鉴上写到、被列名的那一套，到 1958 年这套经济成了年鉴里的一行。
economy 意为“经济、经济体”，父亲一月写道，整件事的经济之事是一个港口和十四个冬天的讲述。
economy 意为“经济、经济体”，我记得的是年鉴上列名的那一套，1970 年转好了，至今仍被说成港口里最安静的一栏。
economy 为抽象总称，母亲 1972 年说，一套经济是唯一会因为被好好讲述而变得更好的东西。
